usage: xo symbols [--dir=DIR] [--pub] [--json|--text] [DIR]

The declarations of one directory's own files, private ones too; --pub
lists the exported surface only. At a root with no .xo files of its
own, the directories below that have them are named.

Output is text at a terminal and JSON otherwise; --json or --text
chooses. Exit status: 0 with an answer, 1 for no match, 2 for a usage
error.
